records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Day 6, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets. Two outbound emails ([email:f8c6e2f0], [email:3bc01c6d]) drew no reply, and internal notes show no contact yet ([slack:dc9967ef], [slack:1fb3ae07]). Starter plan, single admin, no engagement signal — unaided activation in 8 days is unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first project up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Checking in on your first week with Wrenfield. The usual first step is a project — projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them — and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for your team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you.

Best,
Priya
